sloka: अप्रमेयम् हि तत् तेजो यस्य सा जनकात्मजा ।न त्वम् समर्थः ताम् हर्तुम् राम चाप आश्रयाम् वने ॥३-३७-१८॥
transliteration: aprameyam hi tat tejo yasya sā janakātmajā ।na tvam samarthaḥ tām hartum rāma cāpa āśrayām vane ॥3-37-18॥

translations.english: Immeasurable indeed is the power of Rama to whom Sita, daughter of Janaka belongs. You are not competent to kidnap her, for she is under the refuge of Rama's bow in the forest.
